title: DTA-GT: Direction- and Topology-Aware Graph Transformer for Neural Network Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.16822v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Architecture attribute predictors reduce the cost of neural architecture search by estimating accuracy or latency from a small set of evaluated candidates. The key difficulty is that neural architectures are operation-labeled DAGs: edge direction defines computational flow, but existing predictors often treat direction as a local structural cue. We propose DTA-GT, a Direction- and Topology-Aware Graph Transformer based on encoder-wide directional consistency, which preserves directed computational semantics across node initialization, global spectral encoding, pairwise interaction, and feature update. DTA-GT realizes this principle with direction- and topology-aware node initialization, Magnetic Laplacian spectral encoding, direction-dual structural attention, and a Direction-Sensitive MoE-FFN. Across accuracy and latency prediction on NAS-Bench-101 and NAS-Bench-201, DTA-GT consistently outperforms representative sequence-, GNN-, Tran

translated_title: DTA-GT：用于神经网络表示学习的方向与拓扑感知图Transformer
translated_abstract: 架构属性预测器通过从小规模已评估的候选集中估计精度或延迟，来降低神经架构搜索的成本。其关键难点在于神经架构是带有操作标签的有向无环图（DAG）：边的方向定义了计算流，但现有预测器往往仅将方向视为局部结构线索。我们提出了DTA-GT，一种基于编码器级方向一致性的方向与拓扑感知图Transformer，它在节点初始化、全局谱编码、成对交互和特征更新等各个环节中都保持了有向计算语义。DTA-GT通过方向与拓扑感知的节点初始化、磁拉普拉斯谱编码、方向对偶结构注意力以及方向敏感的MoE-FFN来实现这一原则。在NAS-Bench-101和NAS-Bench-201上的精度与延迟预测任务中，DTA-GT持续优于代表性的序列模型、GNN和Transformer方法。
tldr: 提出DTA-GT，一种方向与拓扑感知的图Transformer，通过在节点初始化、谱编码、注意力交互和特征更新全流程中保持有向计算语义，显著提升了神经架构搜索中精度与延迟预测的性能。
en_tdlr: DTA-GT is a direction- and topology-aware graph transformer that preserves directed computational semantics across the entire encoding pipeline, consistently outperforming existing predictors for accuracy and latency prediction in neural architecture search.
